headline: Approved sorority conversion at 371 Main Street and two school building projects at 110 Institute Road; tree clearing at 246 Riverside Ave continued.
summary: Votes on the two Institute Road projects and the sorority conversion were unanimous. The tree-clearing review at 246 Riverside Ave was moved to July 21, 2026, after the applicant asked for a delay, and the continuance includes a cutting inventory of the trees removed.
decisions: Approved addition to wood chip plant building at 110 Institute Road, 5-0.
Approved auxiliary storage building and salt shed at 110 Institute Road, 5-0.
Approved change of use from dormitory to sorority house at 371 Main Street, 6-0.
Continued after-the-fact tree clearing at 246 Riverside Ave to July 21, 2026, with a cutting inventory of trees removed, 6-0.

# BURLINGTON DEVELOPMENT REVIEW BOARD

**Tuesday, July 7, 2026, 5:00 PM**

## MINUTES

*Hybrid & In Person (at 645 Pine Street) Meeting*

**Board Members Present:** AJ LaRosa, Evan Gould, Geoff Hand (5:05 PM), Sean McKenzie, Chase Taylor, and Miles Waite

**Board Members Absent:** Caitlin Halpert and Marina Campbell

**Staff Members Present:** Scott Gustin, Mary O'Neil, and Joseph Cava

**Staff Members Absent:** Kirk Dressing and Collin Naheedy

## Agenda Outline

- I. Agenda
- II. Communications
- III. Minutes
- IV. Consent

## IV. Consent

1. **ZP-26-274; 110 Institute Road (I, Ward 4) Burlington School Dept / David Marshall**
Proposed addition to the existing wood chip plant building. (Project Manager, Scott Gustin)
David Marshall: Sworn in.

AJ LaRosa: This item is recommended for consent approval. Is the applicant present to speak on this application, and do you have any questions or comments concerning the information outlined in the staff report?

David Marshall: Yes, and I have no questions or comments.

AJ LaRosa: Would anyone on the Board have an issue with treating this item as consent? Hearing none, are there any questions or comments from the Board? Hearing none, is there anyone from the public present in person or online wishing to speak on this application? Hearing none, is there anyone that would like to make a motion?

AJ LaRosa: Motioned to approve and adopt staff findings and recommendations, Miles Waite 2nd. Vote 5-0. Motion carried.

2. **ZP-26-286; 110 Institute Road (I, Ward 4) Burlington School Dept / David Marshall**
Proposed construction of an auxiliary storage building and a salt shed at the north end of campus. (Project Manager, Scott Gustin)
David Marshall: Sworn in.

AJ LaRosa: This item is recommended for consent approval. Is the applicant present to speak on this application, and do you have any questions or comments concerning the information outlined in the staff report?

David Marshall: Yes, and I have no questions or comments.

AJ LaRosa: Would anyone on the Board have an issue with treating this item as consent? Hearing none, are there any questions or comments from the Board? Hearing none, is there anyone from the public present in person or online wishing to speak on this application? Hearing none, is there anyone that would like to make a motion?

AJ LaRosa: Motioned to approve and adopt staff findings and recommendations, Miles Waite 2nd. Vote 5-0. Motion carried.

## V. Public Hearing

1. **ZP-26-192; 371 Main Street (I, Ward 8) Champlain College / Frances Smyth**
Proposed change of use from a dormitory to a sorority house. (Project Manager, Mary O'Neil)
Nancy Smith, Nic Anderson, and Sharon Bushor: Sworn in.

AJ LaRosa: Is the applicant present to speak on this application?

Nancy Smith: We are waiting for someone to be present online to speak on this application.

AJ LaRosa: Can you tell us about this project?

Nancy Smith: We would like to convert the existing building into sorority housing.

AJ LaRosa: What is the current use of the property?

Nic Anderson: It is student housing for Champlain College.

AJ LaRosa: Are there any questions or comments from the Board? Hearing none, is there anyone from the public present in person or online wishing to speak on this application?

Sharon Bushor: I want to speak in support of this project. In addition, I support the level of supervision detailed in the project permit conditions.

AJ LaRosa: Are there any additional questions or comments? Hearing none, is there anyone that would like to make a motion?

AJ LaRosa: Motioned to approve and adopt staff findings and recommendations, Geoff Hand 2nd. Vote 6-0. Motion carried.

## VI. Certificate of Appropriateness

1. **ZP-26-231; 246 Riverside Ave (NAC-R, Ward 1) Gedoola, LLC / Eric Jacobs**
After-the-fact tree clearing. (Project Manager, Kirk Dressing)

AJ LaRosa: Is the applicant present to speak on this application?

Scott Gustin: I will see if the applicant is present and available online to speak on this project.

AJ LaRosa: If the applicant is not present, then the Board can decide on a date certain to push this agenda item to.

Scott Gustin: I see a comment from the applicant within the original permit application submittal requesting to defer this agenda item.

AJ LaRosa: We can continue this, and we should. Would anyone like to make a motion?

AJ LaRosa: I move that we continue this to the 7/21/26 DRB meeting, including a cutting inventory of the number trees removed, Geoff Hand 2nd. Vote 6-0. Motion carried.

## VII. Adjournment

Hearing closed at 5:15 PM.

Alexander J. LaRosa, Chair of Development Review Board — Date: 7-21-26

Joseph H. Cava, Permitting & Inspections Permit Technician — Date: 7-21-26
